title: Sindh Civil Servants Regularization of Absorption Act 2011

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Civil Servants Regularization of Absorption Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 2011
ACT XVII OF 2011
SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (REGULARIZATION
OF ABSORPTION) ACT, 2011
An Act to provide for regularization of the
services
of certain employees absorbed as civil servants,
in various departments of Government
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
15th June, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-16/2011, dated 15-6-2011.---The Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Absorption) Bill,
2011, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 6th June, 2011 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 15th June, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient
in the public interest to provide for regularization of the services of certain
employees absorbed as civil servants, in various departments of Government, in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Sindh civil Servants
(Regularization of Absorption) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

2. Definitions.--In this Act, unless the
context otherwise requires--
(a) "absorption"
means and includes absorption of any employee of Federal Government,
Government, Corporation, Council, Statutory body or any authority established
and controlled by the Federal Government or Government;
(b) "Government" means the
Government of Sindh; and
(c) "Post" means any post in
any grade sanctioned by Government and in any existing group or cadre in connection with the affairs of the Province.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Civil Servants Regularization of Absorption Act 2011
sections.description:
Regularization of absorption of certain civil servants

ACT XVII OF 2011
ACT XVII OF 2011
SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (REGULARIZATION
OF ABSORPTION) ACT, 2011
An Act to provide for regularization of the
services
of certain employees absorbed as civil servants,
in various departments of Government
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
15th June, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-16/2011, dated 15-6-2011.---The Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Absorption) Bill,
2011, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 6th June, 2011 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 15th June, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient
in the public interest to provide for regularization of the services of certain
employees absorbed as civil servants, in various departments of Government, in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
3. Regularization of absorption of certain
civil servants.---(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 or rules made thereunder, or in any decree, order or judgment of a court,
an employees absorbed as a civil servant against a post in connection with the
affairs of the Province and holding such post on or before the date of
commencement of this Act, shall be deemed to have been validly absorbed to that
post on regular basis with effect from the date of his absorption.
(2) A civil servants absorbed against any
equivalent post in Government shall, for the purpose of determining his
seniority, be given benefit of his regular service in the equivalent post held
by him before absorption.
